JUMBO BUCKS's prizes make it a game with most of its money in small, frequent prizes. Of the prize money still unclaimed, most is in wins under $1,000. The prize counts change every day, but this design does not.

If you play "MEGA BUCKS" often, bookmark this page. The write-up is updated with each morning's data.

1641.headline: A close look at the prizes

1642.body:
"$500,000 CASH BLITZ" offers a top prize of $500,000 and six prize levels in all. The prize money leans toward many smaller prizes. Games shaped like this give out wins often, but rarely large ones. This design never changes, while every other number on this page does.

The numbers for "$500,000 CASH BLITZ" are recalculated every morning, and this page changes with them.

1643.body:

The numbers for "WILD 9S" are recalculated every morning, and this page changes with them.
1643.headline: Fewer $9,000 prizes left

1644.body:
One of MONEY ROLL's top prizes was claimed four days ago. A player in Florida won $50,000. The game started with six top prizes and now has five top prizes. Nothing bigger can change on a scratcher.

The numbers for "MONEY ROLL" will change a little by tomorrow, and this page will change with them.
1644.headline: The top prize list got shorter

1645.body:
"BLACK PEARLS" is down to three top prizes after a $1 million winner was claimed over a week ago. The game started with four top prizes. Know that before you buy, because a change in top prizes changes the whole game.

The numbers for "BLACK PEARLS" will change a little by tomorrow, and this page will change with them.
1645.headline: Another top prize was claimed

1646.body:
"$2,000,000 SPECTACULAR" can match another game on price and top prize and still pay out very differently. This game is a game with most of its money in small, frequent prizes. Of its unclaimed prize money, about three-quarters is in wins under $1,000 and the rest is in bigger prizes. Neither kind is better, and each suits different players.

Each day without a top prize claim on "$2,000,000 SPECTACULAR", the remaining top prizes are spread across fewer unsold tickets. The number of tickets printed is fixed.

Everything above about "$2,000,000 SPECTACULAR" comes from the Florida Lottery's own published numbers. We only do the counting.
1646.headline: What type of game it is

1647.body:
Of the unclaimed prize money on "$15,000,000 PLATINUM PAYOUT", most is in wins under $5,000. The game is a game built around small prizes that are won often. That is neither good nor bad, only how it was designed. Choose the kind of game that fits the win you want.

Every line of $15,000,000 PLATINUM PAYOUT's prize table below shows today's count, not last month's.
